recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片上兩群中型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，多顆芽細胞核內可見淡色的杯狀凹陷（cup-shaped nuclear invagination），細胞質少、無顆粒，是 NPM1/FLT3-ITD 突變 AML 常見的杯狀芽細胞。
features: Two clusters of medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine chromatin; several with a pale central nuclear invagination (cup-like)
Scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
One disrupted cell with coarse granular cytoplasm and a small lymphocyte nearby
Background red cells with occasional teardrop forms and platelet clumps
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows clusters of medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts display a pale nuclear invagination producing a cup-shaped or fish-mouth nuclear appearance. Auer rods are not seen; a smudged granular cell and a small lymphocyte are also present, and the background contains occasional teardrop red cells and platelet clumps. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, which in this patient was AML with mutated NPM1 and FLT3-ITD.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL blasts have bilobed or reniform nuclei with fine granules and strong MPO, and carry PML::RARA.
Monocytic blasts have more abundant gray cytoplasm, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity rather than a discrete cup-shaped invagination.
Lymphoblasts are MPO-negative and lymphoid-marker positive, although cup-like nuclei can occasionally occur.
